result: Warmup mainly lets training tolerate a larger target learning rate: as η_t rises, catapults push the network to flatter regions so the sharpness tracks 2/η_t. For Adam the relevant quantity is the preconditioned sharpness, which starts huge; initializing v₀ = g₀² (GI-Adam) lowers it by √(1 − β2).
result_plain: Warmup lets larger target learning rates train by reducing (preconditioned) sharpness via catapults.
